confidence_notes: Sources for food and drink were found by web search. They were cost-of-living summaries that mostly rely on Numbeo-style crowdsourced data from about May–June 2026 (Expatica, Idealista, MyLifeElsewhere, portugalbuyersagent.com). Inexpensive meal: about EUR 12.5. Mid-range three-course meal for two: about EUR 35–40, raised slightly for the July peak season. Cappuccino: about EUR 1.6–1.95. Draft beer: about EUR 2.5–3.1 per 0.5 L. Glass of wine: a non-Faro-specific Algarve guide gives about EUR 3–4, and a national average is about EUR 4. No Faro cocktail price was found, so the cocktail figure is an estimate based on typical Portuguese ratios to beer and wine (about 2.5–3x beer) and is less certain. EUR amounts were converted to USD at about 1.10, using RBA cross rates from November 2026. Accommodation figures were not searched. They are general-knowledge estimates for Faro's July peak season and are the least certain anchors, possibly off by 20–30%.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based mainly on Faro-specific crowdsourced data. Accommodation is benchmarked against other southern Portuguese and Iberian coastal tourist cities in high season, such as Lagos, Portimão and smaller Andalusian coastal towns. These sit below Lisbon and above inland Portugal.
